generation.plan: Variable warped landforms, seeded base sites and self-avoiding regional road walks; lowland A* routes around lakes and graded roads; shape/material/road/passage WFC preserves local sockets.
generation.lakes: 1-3 independent basins; symmetric plans mirror to 2-6. Dry rims and an eight-neighbor flood keep lake centers separate from the sea.
generation.tunnels: Opposite diagonal to bases, seeded entrances and depths, two or four wide chambers, dry 3D route search with optional multi-leg connections.
generation.coastline: Two-tile submerged boundary sockets applied after shoulder blending. An extended seabed shelf meets those sockets and reaches quarter-floor -12 six tiles offshore.
generation.naval: Separate 96-square depth/connectivity grid, sea-only flood and draft-sensitive route query. Conservative tile-sized footprint; lakes do not connect through tunnels.

diversity.release_v6: 24 seeds per fixed-settings cohort (symmetric and asymmetric), floor 6/6, temperate, tunnels enabled. Reported metrics compare every pair; no material or prop differences enter these measurements.
diversity.metric_note: Occupancy difference is symmetric difference divided by union (1 minus Jaccard overlap). Coarse silhouettes contain 64 majority-land blocks. Baseline and release cohorts have different sizes.

rendering.camera: Extended pan/zoom bounds and distant orthographic eye prevent near-plane clipping when viewing the ocean. Ocean extent button frames the naval area.
rendering.assets: Existing procedural detailed trees/props, material shaders, shadows and planar water reflections retained.

verified: In-page New world produces visibly different landforms and lake arrangements at identical settings
Finished beaches and cliffs around the land region
Ocean access overlay covers sea-connected water and excludes inland lakes
Wide ocean framing without exposed mesh/near-plane clipping
Two- and four-chamber tunnel isolation with ceilings hidden/shown
Entrance, auto cutaway, horizontal section and solid terrain
Unchanged world hash through inspection toggles
Continuous tile boundaries and readable navigation overlays
Volcanic emission remains distinct under darker lighting
browser_review.performance_scope: UI samples, not a sustained benchmark. Browser loading and regeneration still perform synchronous meshing and GPU preparation; temporary low FPS occurs. Mobile not measured.
browser_review.console: No warn/error entries in packaged page.

limitations: Generator v6 changes worlds produced by older seed URLs.
Lakes currently share one ocean water datum; no elevated lakes, hydrology or flooded tunnels.
Naval navigation groundwork only: ships, naval combat and dynamic water are not implemented.
Regional road search is bounded to jittered 4x4 lattices; complete search exhaustion reports failure.
Terrain and props are static; this remains a map/navigation study, not an AlienWars combat or RL policy.
